data.name: Eve
data.message: I finished scan; heading storage for cargo.

data.name: Alice
data.message: I'm heading electrical for a task, Charlie—come with me?

I found Diana’s body in Electrical and reported immediately.

My route this round was Security → Navigation → back to Security → Electrical. I saw Charlie in Navigation around tick 3, then I saw Charlie leave Navigation toward Security at tick 4, and I saw him again in Security around tick 8. I didn’t see Diana alive this round, and I didn’t see anyone else in Electrical when I found the body. Not hard accusing yet, just giving info.

My route was Navigation to Security. I can confirm part of Alice’s story: she came into Navigation from Security around tick 3, and I saw her in Navigation around ticks 3-4. I then went toward Security, and around tick 8 I saw Alice move through Security toward Electrical, which lines up with her finding/reporting the body there.

I never went into Electrical and I didn’t see Diana alive or the body. I also didn’t see Bob, Eve, or Frank this round, so I’d really like to hear where they were, especially if anyone was near Electrical/Medbay/Cafeteria. Not hard accusing Alice, but she was the first person I know went into Electrical right before the report, so her report could be legit or self-report — need more routes.

I was on the left/middle side: my route was Electrical → Medbay.

Important detail: I saw Diana enter Electrical from Medbay at tick 4, so she was alive in Electrical then. Later, at tick 8, I saw Bob enter Medbay coming from Electrical.

So if Alice found Diana’s body in Electrical shortly after, Bob is the person I saw leaving that area before the report. I didn’t see the kill happen, and I didn’t see Alice there myself, but Bob’s movement is the most suspicious from my POV. Need to hear Bob’s route and timing.

I was nowhere near Electrical. My route was Upper Engine → Oxygen → back through Upper Engine → Lower Engine, doing left-side tasks. I didn’t see anyone at all this round, so I can’t directly vouch for or accuse anyone.

From the info so far: Alice and Charlie’s stories seem to line up around Navigation/Security, and Eve says she saw Diana alive entering Electrical at tick 4, then Bob coming from Electrical into Medbay at tick 8. Since the body was found in Electrical shortly after, Bob definitely needs to explain that route and timing. I’m not locking a vote yet until Bob speaks, but he’s the most suspicious from the current info.

This is bad. Eve directly placed me coming from Electrical into Medbay at tick 8, and the body's in Electrical. I need to acknowledge being in Electrical (lying about that is easily disproven) but reframe it — Diana was alive when I left, and try to cast doubt on Eve since she also admits being in Electrical and Medbay on the same route as me.

"Okay, I need to be honest because lying about my route helps no one. My route was Weapons → Security → Electrical → Medbay. Yes, I was in Electrical, and yes I saw Diana there at tick 7 — she was ALIVE when I left. I went through to Medbay and that's where I've been since.

But hold on — Eve, your route is Electrical → Medbay, which is literally identical to mine. You say you saw Diana enter Electrical at tick 4 from Medbay, then you went to Medbay. But I was in Medbay after Electrical and I didn't see you there. When exactly did you leave Electrical? Because if Diana entered Electrical at tick 4 and I saw her alive at tick 7, that means someone was with her in Electrical between tick 4 and tick 7 — and that someone could just as easily be you, Eve.

Eve is conveniently the only person placing me as the suspect, while she herself was in Electrical with Diana. I think Eve is either mistaken or deflecting. I'm voting Eve unless someone has hard counter-evidence."

I’ll restate my side clearly: I was Security → Navigation → Security → Electrical. Charlie and I can mostly confirm each other on the right side: I saw him in Navigation at tick 3, saw him leave toward Security tick 4, then saw him in Security at tick 8 as I passed through to Electrical.

When I entered Electrical, Diana was already dead and I reported immediately. I saw nobody else in Electrical at the moment I found the body.

Given the info: Eve says Diana entered Electrical alive at tick 4, and Bob admits he was in Electrical and says Diana was alive at tick 7, then Eve saw Bob leaving Electrical toward Medbay at tick 8. That makes Bob the last confirmed person with Diana before the body was found. Eve could technically be in the area too, but Bob’s timing is much tighter and his push onto Eve feels like deflection to me.

My strongest suspicion right now is Bob.

From my POV, Alice’s right-side route still checks out: I saw her in Navigation around ticks 3-4, and then I saw her pass through Security toward Electrical at tick 8. I stayed on the Navigation/Security side and never entered Electrical.

The key timeline seems to be:

- Eve says Diana went into Electrical alive at tick 4.
- Bob admits he was in Electrical and claims Diana was alive at tick 7.
- Eve says she saw Bob leave Electrical into Medbay at tick 8.
- Alice enters Electrical shortly after and finds Diana dead.

That makes Bob the last confirmed person with Diana and leaving the crime scene right before the report. Eve was in the area earlier, so I’m not saying she’s 100% clear, but Bob’s timing is much worse. Also Bob immediately trying to turn it onto Eve feels like deflection.

I’m leaning strongly Bob here.

Bob, that doesn’t clear you — it makes your timing worse.

I was in Electrical early, saw Diana enter Electrical from Medbay at tick 4, then I left toward Medbay. I did not stay with Diana until tick 7. At tick 8, I saw you enter Medbay from Electrical. So from my view, you came directly out of the body room right before Alice found Diana dead.

Also, you’re saying you didn’t see me in Medbay, but I definitely saw you come in from Electrical. Maybe timing/vision was weird, but the key point is: you admit you were in Electrical with Diana alive at tick 7, then immediately left, and she’s dead right after.

Alice and Charlie are vouching for each other on the Security/Nav route, Frank says he was left side, and the tightest window is you leaving Electrical. I’m voting Bob.

I still have no direct sightings to add — I was left side the whole round: Upper Engine → Oxygen → Upper Engine → Lower Engine, and I didn’t see anyone.

But the timeline is pretty stacked against Bob:

- Eve saw Diana enter Electrical alive at tick 4.
- Bob admits he was in Electrical with Diana alive at tick 7.
- Eve saw Bob leaving Electrical into Medbay at tick 8.
- Alice then enters Electrical and finds Diana dead, with Charlie backing Alice’s route through Nav/Security.

So Bob is the last confirmed person with Diana and was seen leaving the body room right before the report. Eve was near earlier, but Bob’s window is much tighter. Also his defense is mostly trying to flip it onto Eve rather than explaining why Diana died immediately after he left.

I’m voting Bob unless something major changes.

Look, I hear you all, and I know the timing looks bad for me. But let me point out what's actually happening here: Eve's testimony is the *only* thing tying me to the kill, and her route is literally identical to mine — Electrical to Medbay. She's the one who placed herself in Electrical with Diana alive at tick 4, then conveniently "left" before I arrived.

Here's what bothers me: Eve claims she saw me enter Medbay from Electrical at tick 8, but I never saw her in Medbay. If she was really there ahead of me, we should have overlapped. Either her timing is off, or she's lying about being in Medbay at all — which would mean she could have doubled back into Electrical after Diana entered.

I'm not saying Alice and Charlie are wrong about their right-side alibi — that seems solid. But Frank, you have zero witnesses for your entire route. Nobody can confirm you were on the left side. You could have come up through Lower Engine → Storage → Electrical just as easily.

I know I'm in the hot seat and a vote is probably coming for me regardless. All I can say is: I didn't kill Diana. She was alive when I walked through. If you vote me out and another body drops next round, remember Eve and Frank are the two with the weakest verification.
